facts.claim: In December, the aggregate of mortality experienced a marked reduction.
facts.quote: In December there was a marked reduction in the aggregate of mortality.
Cholera attacked Bangalore in September, and in November the mortality amounted to 225, and December to 95.

facts.claim: The total registered mortality amounted to 3,139.
facts.quote: The total mortality registered amounted to 3,139, of which 1,828 were males and 1,311 females.
